chapter.heading: Psalm 44
Come to Our Help
To the choirmaster. A Maskil(1) of the Sons of Korah.
chapter.v: in the days of old:
butthem you set free;
for you delighted in them.
ordain salvation for Jacob!
tread down those who rise up against us.
nor can my sword save me.
put to shame those who hate us.
and we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah
have not gone out with our armies.
and those who hate us have gotten spoil.
scattered us among the nations.
demanding no high price for them.
scorn of those around us.
a laughingstock among the peoples.
shame has covered my face
the enemy and the avenger.
and we have not been false to your covenant.
departed from your way;
the shadow of death.
a foreign god,
For he knows the secrets of the heart.
we are regarded as sheep to be slaughtered.
Do not reject us forever!
Why do you forget our affliction and oppression?
our belly clings to the ground.
Redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love!
